application: Reviewable replacement package design. Not imported by checkout, signup, sales chat or provider admission. No existing customer price, entitlement, free access, Stripe Price or activation setting changes.
headline: Choose the help your shop needs.
introduction: Calls, texts and website inquiries handled around your workday. Start with front-desk coverage, add follow-through, or bring your paid leads into the same workflow.

scope.basis: Per business location. More locations, numbers, calendars or shared team access require a specific Enterprise scope; no unimplemented seats, consolidated billing or SSO are promised.
scope.automaticSetup: Business facts supplied once; managed resources prepared in the background after the customer authorizes the service. Customers still grant Google/platform permissions, choose phone routing and approve legal/carrier details and any quoted external charges. Website installation requires authorized access to the customer's website. No collection of customer platform passwords.
scope.customerOwnerHandoff: A request and its context are retained for the shop. No guaranteed job, dispatch, emergency response or staffed human answering service.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.description: More locations, higher volume or a specific integration. A written scope and price for the way your team works.

units.period: The customer's monthly subscription period, anchored to the accepted billing contract; not the legacy Houston calendar-month informational counter. No unused-unit rollover.
units.voiceMinutes: Connected time on each hosted phone leg, including a connected handoff leg; round each connected leg up to the next minute. A call and its transfer may use more than one minute at the same time. Unanswered legs and verified duplicate reports consume no customer units. Provider-event identity must prevent double counting. Known pre-answer blocked spam consumes no customer units; no promise that every answered unwanted call is free.
units.outgoingSmsSegments: Carrier segments sent from the service to customers or to an owner receiving SMS alerts. One long message can use several segments. Incoming texts do not reduce this outgoing allowance; their supplier cost is included in the model. Carrier-accepted sends count even if the handset later rejects delivery. Pre-provider failures, simulations, verified duplicates and required STOP/HELP control responses consume no customer units. Unknown sends remain reserved until reconciled; never repeat blindly.
units.writtenAiReplies: One logical completed AI answer delivered to a customer through website chat, service SMS or an included native lead platform. Retries, model/tool calls, classifications, inbound messages, owner-written replies, internal tests and failed deliveries do not each become a customer reply. Provider cost for all physical attempts must still be budgeted. SMS AI replies also consume their outgoing transport segments; voice AI is covered by minutes instead.
units.leads: No charge per purchased lead, job or imported source record. A repeated webhook cannot create another billable reply. This is not an unlimited lead-storage, inbound-abuse or infinite conversation guarantee.
units.twoLimitsExample: Ten AI-written SMS answers delivered in two segments each use 10 written replies and 20 outgoing SMS segments. A customer-typed reply uses neither outgoing segments nor an AI reply.

connectors.name: Thumbtack
connectors.target: Read and answer the customer's original Thumbtack conversation, retain scope and source context, ask relevant qualifying questions and allow owner takeover.
connectors.route: Partner OAuth and native message API, authorized for the shop's Pro account.
connectors.currentState: Native adapter and guarded AI exist locally/published behind gates; partner application submitted, approved credentials and actual delivery not accepted.

connectors.name: Angi
connectors.target: Import lead details into the shared inbox, qualify the request and help the owner follow up through an eligible, permission-backed channel.
connectors.route: Angi lead delivery webhook; owner/source contact workflow. No in-Angi chat write contract is established by the reviewed documentation.
connectors.currentState: Tenant-scoped intake and owner contact workflow implemented. Autonomous Angi SMS/email conversation is not implemented or accepted; any future automated outreach is a distinct delivery requirement, not a native Angi reply.

additionalSources.policy: Evaluate an integration request and quote only an implemented, authorized and tested scope. A vendor API or Enterprise label alone does not establish our connector. Google Calendar permission does not grant Google Ads/LSA access.

commercialTerms.commitment: Month to month. Cancellation takes effect at the displayed paid renewal end; immediate service pause is a separate control. Renewal date and paid service start must be shown before acceptance.
commercialTerms.atCapacity: Proposed paid behavior: show usage and warn at 80% and 100%; offer an explicitly priced upgrade or capacity quote without auto-charging. Pause only exhausted automation and retain the inquiry for owner action; use the previously authorized call fallback. Never represent an unconfirmed provider action as completed. This is an implementation requirement, not currently enforced monthly entitlement behavior.
commercialTerms.externalCosts: Thumbtack/Angi subscriptions, purchased leads, advertising, the customer's existing carrier and taxes are separate. Standard recurring managed number and campaign costs are included in the model. One-time carrier brand/vetting fees must be specifically quoted and accepted before texting activation; no unknown fee is silently treated as zero.
commercialTerms.setup: Guided automated setup is included. No mandatory specialist fee selected. An optional specialist engagement for custom website/CRM work must have a separate scope and fixed quote before work; no invented industry-standard fee.
commercialTerms.trial: Free workspace preparation and private testing remain separate from the paid offer. No timed trial or paid subscription begins just by choosing a package in setup.
excluded: unaccepted native CRM or dispatch connections
payment processing for the shop's customers

compatibility.existingOffers: Preserve accepted offer version, amount, provider Price ID, currency, interval, account, mode, agreed allowances and customer rights. These new IDs are not aliases that reprice starter/growth/pro.
compatibility.freeWorkspace: Do not reduce existing free workspace capabilities or portray a shared daily best-effort ceiling as reserved paid capacity. New paid monthly capacity must be funded separately.
compatibility.billingMaintenance: Fix retained Checkout, Subscription, Portal and cancellation verification to bind to immutable accepted offer/Price data before modifying any current price map. Keep authorized legacy maintenance isolated from new admissions and its old trial/fallback behavior.
compatibility.marketingCutover: A single future release must align pricing, signup, onboarding, sales chat, workspace quote, checkout validation, ledgers and entitlements. This proposal deliberately changes none of those runtime sources.

activationGates: Current managed phone, texting/carrier, Calendar, billing and operational outcomes accepted independently under launch control
Native partner/source access and actual same-thread delivery for each advertised connector
Versioned new admission and immutable existing-offer maintenance, with no implicit repricing
Atomic per-period monthly entitlements, fair per-tenant capacity, deduplication, failed/uncertain action accounting and visible exhaustion recovery
Funded measured model routing, bounded context/physical attempts and English/Spanish quality without degraded answers
Actual cost receipts and partner charges reviewed against the conservative model; real buyer validation of the fixed offer
Customer-facing copy and ordinary desktop/mobile journey accepted; no live subscription on an unavailable promised channel
